'''Sarn Vals''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Sarn Vals was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an infant and [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Eventually completing training and passing the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], Vals was elevated to the rank of Jedi Knight by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="BTT" /> Serving the Order throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a violent and costly conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Vals was able to survive an attack by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The Grand Army, which the Order had fought alongside and commanded during the entire conflict, turned on their Jedi leaders when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] betrayed the Jedi and initiated [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] in a secret scheme to destroy the Order.<ref name="BTT" />

Fleeing into exile, Vals escaped to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and went to ground. However, when a disturbance was reported in the sector, the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] traced it back to the fugitive Vals and sent agents to locate and destroy the Quarren Jedi outlaw.<ref name="BTT" />
